# platform_ldap_group (Resource)

Registers an existing LDAP group in JFrog with the LDAP group import. The members stay managed in LDAP. Changing `name` or `group_dn` replaces the group, and destroying the resource deletes the group in JFrog, so check the permissions and roles that reference the group before either. See [LDAP Groups](https://jfrog.com/help/r/jfrog-platform-administration-documentation/ldap-groups).

Creating the resource fails if the group already exists in JFrog. Import it instead.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "platform_ldap_group" "my-ldap-group" {
  name               = "my-ldap-group"
  group_dn           = "cn=my-ldap-group,ou=Groups,dc=example,dc=com"
  ldap_group_setting = "my-ldap-setting"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_dn` (String) DN of the group in LDAP, for example `cn=my-group,ou=Groups,dc=example,dc=com`.
- `ldap_group_setting` (String) Name of an existing LDAP group setting. Its search settings are used to import the group. Only read when the group is created.
- `name` (String) Name of the group in JFrog.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax, with the LDAP group setting name and the group name:

```sh
terraform import platform_ldap_group.my-ldap-group my-ldap-setting/my-ldap-group
```
